name: Kiskunfélegyháza (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kiskunfélegyháza: a crowned blue shield with a white church and a figure within a yellow baroque frame.
history: The present flag of Kiskunfélegyháza was adopted in 2008, replacing the flag used through the 1990s. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kiskunfélegyháza arms with crown and frame
